KyberSwap AMM is a decentralized exchange that operates as an automated market maker. KyberSwap AMM runs on public blockchains and is built on smart contracts. KyberSwap AMM allows liquidity providers to supply assets to trading pools.

Akropolis is a decentralized finance protocol. Akropolis operates on the Ethereum public blockchain using smart contracts.

Betdice is a decentralized dice betting application. Betdice runs on a public blockchain without a central intermediary.
